{{Quote|The ''Blood Ambition'' will be hyperspace ready in two days.|Ralchio Nervi, to Nath Alico|<ref name="FLT" />}}
The '''''Blood Ambition''''' was a [[Gladiator II-class Star Destroyer|''Gladiator II''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Armada" /> in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was commanded by [[Captain]] [[Ralchio Nervi/Legends|Ralchio Nervi]] and was part of a [[Ralchio Nervi's task force/Legends|task force]] along with [[Sargantuan/Legends|''Sargantuan'']] and [[Warhawk/Legends|''Warhawk'']].<ref name="FLT" />
